title: INT8 MobileNets for plant disease recognition: code and results
description:
Code, run records and results for the manuscript Auditing INT8 quantization of MobileNets for plant disease recognition: compression accounting, an outlier-aware fix and behavior under field shift (K. Medhi and S. K. Kalita, submitted to Computers and Electronics in Agriculture).

Contents: the experiment notebook generator (v2.3.0) and generated notebook, Kaggle run scripts with the exact notebooks that ran, aggregation, figure and evidence scripts with their saved outputs, per-run configurations and reports for six training runs (MobileNetV2 and MobileNetV3-Small, three seeds), the shared PlantVillage data split, the pre-registered pilot plan and the research log. Large files (model weights, checkpoints and saved model outputs) are archived in a separate Zenodo dataset record. The PlantVillage and PlantDoc datasets are not redistributed.
